verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is a payments SaaS that handles merchant and transaction data and advertises AI-driven features, so an opt-out from AI model training is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack has nothing on AI-training data use, opt-out controls, or a training-data policy. The cited items cover payment APIs, the MCP server, agentic commerce, and AI-driven payment optimization, none of which address whether customer data trains models.
